items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Here's a picture of Doc Randall playing clarinet out there in... Yeah. ...in, uh, Las Vegas.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember Eddie McCarthy from pictures and from talking to, uh... Well, anyway, I... Erwin LeClerc. ...a couple of these.

Yeah. These are pretty bad. Oh, here's that other one. Let's take it. These are pretty bad, uh, bad pictures. But, uh... You may have made this, this is a copy of them, you know. But anyway... I told them, I said, I ain't gonna let you have your pictures. I know, after that big argument I had with that call, I said, man, you're gonna get my pictures. That's what, yeah. There's the band, Ed McCarty. Yeah. And Frank Mutz. Mm-hmm. And Piggy Gerberk, Ellis Stratagas. Ellis Stratagas on trombone. And, uh, Eddie Powers…
Yeah. He's with Joe Spora's band, it's there. Huh? Joe Spora's band at City Park.
